name: resume-master
description: ATS-optimised resume generator — multi-user, apply modes, ghost filtering, Excel export, autofill extension

scripts.prestart: node -e "console.log('[start] npm prestart: launching server entrypoint')"
scripts.//test:fast: A232 R1: test:fast = every file that drives no browser (concurrency 3, ~5 min) - run it on every change; test:browser = the real-Chrome / extension / fidelity files (concurrency 1, the fidelity probes filled once first) - before a push. The tier rule is test-support/testTiers.mjs.
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/freePort.mjs && node -e "console.log('[build] npm prebuild: starting root build pipeline')"
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('[build] root build: using existing root install, building client')" && npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.//verify:harness: REQUIRES the app already running on :3001 (node server.js). The runner starts only fakeAts and refuses to start without the app, because a run against a dead port prints nothing for hours. A green board here is NOT evidence about the model-call path — every harness that would exercise it is excluded for spending tokens.
scripts.//walk:extension: J2: a browser pass of the REAL extension on the Workday-shaped fixture. npm run walk:extension -- <scenario> (test-support/walks/<scenario>.mjs; --list, --headful, --theme dark, --require-chrome). No Chrome -> SKIP with the reason, exit 0.
